focus: Contract: restart_pane parse/validation, refusals (host_shell, live pane, unknown, in progress, during shutdown, not attached) with reasons; no payload.

Backend: only a reaped OMP pane restarts; same argv (isolation overlays, --no-extensions, --append-system-prompt "", --no-title, bridge -e; no --resume/--continue), env (same role token, PI_AUTO_QA stripped) and cwd; new pid registers via bridge; phase degraded->ready only when everything is healthy; isolation re-check for that role; concurrent requests serialised; spawn failure leaves a sane exited state and a later retry works; old pane PTY/children cleaned; other panes and the backend untouched; restart history recorded; repeated exit/restart cycles (e.g. 5x) leak no fds/processes; worker and manager both.

Bridge generation: the restarted OMP gets WORKBENCH_G3_GENERATION 1 while the pane generation is 2 - check whether any identity/fencing (mailbox registration, pid match, stale peer from the old process, late messages from the old session) can confuse the two processes.

UI: exited notice + title, Enter (CR/LF, alone or mixed in a read, Hangul IME commit) sends exactly one restart; other bytes, pastes, wheel arrows, terminal query replies not sent to an exited pane; pending dedupe; refusals visible; notice cleared when the new generation arrives; host shell exit unaffected.

Live (real OMP 18.4.4, no model prompt): backend in a temp data dir, SIGKILL the manager OMP PID you started, drive restart through the real product UI in a PTY by pressing Enter on the manager pane; verify new pid, bridge ready, isolation ok, the pane redraws a fresh OMP, the worker OMP and shell PIDs unchanged, clean shutdown verified.
run: tests/backend, tests/contracts, tests/ui (pattern test_*.py, no pipe, real exit code), tests/gates/g1_vt (PYTHONPATH=src:.), the live probe once
rules: Draft expectations from the criteria before reading the implementation. Never modify production code (src/**, omp_bridge/**): keep a failing test red and report it as a finding P0..P3 with file:line. Use /tmp/cw02-g1-venv/bin/python, PYTHONPATH=src, short unique TMPDIR under /tmp removed afterwards; no model prompts; never pkill or pattern kills (only PIDs/servers you started); never touch ~/wb-urux-sandbox, the user's Workbench/herdr/tmux servers or configs, credential stores, ~/.omp ~/.agents ~/.claude ~/.codex; no --profile; no commits, no graphify update; zero residue. A parallel test_designer works on the other C-D62 item: only create/edit the files allowed to you.
result_format: Write the result JSON (checks table, new tests, findings P0..P3, residue). Reply in Korean, <=20 lines.
